# Security Policy

Do not report vulnerabilities, tokens, or household data in public issues.

Use GitHub's **Security > Report a vulnerability** for this repository:
https://github.com/NateGr/sh_chore_tracker/security/advisories/new

If private vulnerability reporting is not yet enabled, use GitHub to request that
the maintainer enable it without describing the vulnerability publicly.

Include affected versions, a minimal reproduction, and potential impact. Redact
credentials, personal names, addresses, and Home Assistant configuration. Never
upload a full `.storage` directory or backup.

Security fixes target the latest stable release. There is no published release
in this repository yet, and older versions will not receive guaranteed backports.
This project does not provide a guaranteed response time.
